- Produced GIS-compatible GeoJSON outputs via overlap-aware postprocessing, enabling downstream geospatial ingestion.

- Co-authored peer-reviewed papers accepted at IEEE ICEPES 2024 and Springer ICETSS 2026.
- Automated experiment tracking and evaluation harnesses, cutting manual analysis time by roughly 40%.

## Graduate Teaching Assistant — SJSU AI&ML Department

- Mentored students on PyTorch, scikit-learn, and statistical evaluation practices.
- Designed practice problem sets covering transformers, optimization, and model evaluation.
